many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bars=[]
    for c in range(w):
        r=h-1
        while r>=0 and grid[r][c]==0:
            r-=1
        if r<2:
            continue
        color=grid[r][c]
        top=r
        while top>=0 and grid[top][c]!=0:
            top-=1
        top+=1
        if r-top+1>=3 and grid[top][c]==color and len(set(grid[rr][c] for rr in range(top+1,r)))==1 and grid[top+1][c]!=color:
            bars.append((r-top-1,c,top,r,color))
    if len(bars)>=2:
        target_length=sorted(set(b[0] for b in bars))[1]
        _,c,top,bottom,color=next(b for b in bars if b[0]==target_length)
        for r in range(top+1,bottom):
            out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
